source.dataset: GSM8K test set (openai/gsm8k), problems 0-9 in order
source.protocol: Du et al., ICML 2024: 3 agents, 2 rounds (answer, then update after reading the others), majority vote
source.description: Three agents solve a grade-school math word problem, read each other's solutions, update their answers, and vote. The answer is checked against the GSM8K answer key.
source.notes: The team is heterogeneous by our choice for the demo: agent_c runs a smaller model and is told to answer quickly without writing out steps.
